description: Scott authored laws ending mandatory minimum sentences for nonviolent drug offenses, eliminating the most overused sentence enhancement, and ensuring innocent people wrongly convicted of crimes can be exonerated and released. In Congress, he’ll support reforms to reduce police use of lethal force, make it easier for the wrongfully convicted to prove their innocence, and ensure our laws are rooted in compassion and rehabilitation.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Scott Wiener for Congress
title: Criminal Justice Reform
